title: Find the in-game measurements
text: In Apex settings, open Gameplay and enable Performance Display to see FPS, latency and packet loss.

title: Choose a nearby data centre
text: Before entering the lobby, use the Data Center option on the launch screen to choose a nearby location.

title: Consider connection activity
text: EA lists wireless connections, shared Wi-Fi traffic and background applications among possible contributors to connection problems.

title: Make the comparison useful
text: Change one factor at a time. Record the conditions and readings before and after the change. An improvement does not by itself establish the underlying cause.

title: Check whether improvement repeats
text: Compare another similar session with the original affected baseline. Record any remaining symptoms. Repeated reported improvement does not establish a root cause or automatically resolve the case.

title: Review verification findings
text: Summarise the recorded verification result and any remaining symptoms. Distinguish reported improvement from measured changes. Repeated reported improvement does not establish the underlying cause or automatically resolve the case.
